listing.style: 1940 rustic Berkeley Hills brown-shingle cabin + separate 1bd cottage; MLS classifies as Residential Income - Duplex
listing.description: Perched in the Berkeley Hills with sweeping views of the Bay, this rare offering pairs a main residence with separate cottage on one lot. The main house has all the warmth of a classic hillside home, with rich wood paneling, beautiful natural light, and real romantic charm. The main level offers two bedrooms and two bathrooms, and the living and dining areas flow easily into the kitchen, with plenty of built-ins along the way. Step out onto the deck, take in the view, and you'll understand right away why this spot is so special. Downstairs, a flexible bonus space with a non-conforming bath makes a great studio, office, or guest retreat. At street level, the separate one-bedroom cottage has Bay views of its own, along with a full kitchen and bath. It's a wonderful setup for visiting family and friends, creative work, or rental income. Lush plantings and a garden patio surround it all, and a covered carport and extra storage add everyday convenience. Tilden Park is just up the road for weekend hikes, and you're only minutes from downtown Berkeley, the shops and restaurants of North Shattuck, schools, and an easy commute to San Francisco. Opportunities like this don't come along often in the Berkeley Hills. Home Energy Score of 2.

verdict: This is a view-and-character play, not a turnkey house: a 1940 brown-shingle Berkeley hills cabin with a legitimate SF-to-Golden-Gate living-level view, real rustic soul (beamed ceilings, Dutch doors, leaded glass), and a separate 1bd cottage whose own bay view makes it a credible income/guest unit. The trade: vintage systems throughout (jalousie windows, original baths, mixed-age appliances), flat roof sections with skylights, a non-conforming downstairs, neighbors 12-30 ft away, and Very High FHSZ insurance friction — priced accordingly at $186K under its 2021 sale. For a solo buyer who ranks view + vibe + flexibility over polish, and who can absorb fire-insurance and permit diligence.
